method: Tokenize Latin V514 and OCR pages, fold diacritics, i/j and u/v; seek up to three distinct verbatim five-word anchors of >=26 chars; accept only unique page, or unique page with at least two anchors. Reject ambiguous matches. No semantic or philological verification. Navigation auto-suggestions restricted to candidates with >=2 distinct matched anchors; single-anchor candidates retained for manual review only.
warning: Machine candidate for navigation only: identical normalized text fragments are not proof of an aligned locus or equivalent edition. Do not silently synchronize pages without an explicit opt-in.

navigationPolicy.manualReview: Candidates with one anchor remain searchable but never trigger linked navigation automatically.
navigationPolicy.verification: No machine candidate is a verified philological alignment.
